plan.vision:
CathMaster becomes a cath lab you operate with your hands rather than a game you play with buttons. It has three layers, all running on one patient clock and all checked against the real cine library.

1. **Image: a measured X-ray chain.**
   - Devices and iodinated vessels are rendered by an analytic round-cone union integrator. The background is anatomy with spectrally matched lung clutter, cortical ribs and vertebrae.
   - The detector stage has hashed per-pixel Poisson noise, a Gaussian MTF and a grey-independent noise floor. Processing is multi-scale harmonisation with auto-windowing and a motion-compensated recursive filter. Automatic dose-rate control is closed-loop.
   - Every stage is tuned against statistics measured from the CC0/CC BY library (scripts/realism), never against patient pixels.
   - Success means two things. First, every metric in measurementTargets falls inside its real-data band. Second, a blinded real-versus-simulated two-choice drill (RealOrSimDrill) gives about 50% correct for experienced readers.

2. **Body: an anatomically and kinematically correct patient.**
   - The cranial/caudal sign is fixed first, because it invalidates every view-dependent calibration.
   - Each case gets a seeded anatomy genome drawn from cited population priors. Vessels are grown by territory with Huo-Kassab calibres and band-limited tortuosity.
   - A time-based heart motion field has the correct twist sign, root and catheter motion, and a diastasis that shortens with heart rate. The heart shape the coronaries sit on is the same one that beats on the image.
   - Contrast is transported along the vessels by 1D advection, driven by a manifold-and-syringe hand injection mixing with phasic coronary flow from physiology.ts.
   - A patient engine (circulation.ts plus responses) drives a 12-lead ECG, a pressure transducer chain with zeroing and levelling, drugs, ischaemia, arrhythmias and tamponade, all from the same CardiacClock as the image.

3. **Hands and mentor: a lab that behaves like a lab.**
   - Catheters and wires are XPBD Cosserat rods in a Web Worker, so engagement, deep seating, prolapse, back-out and wire migration emerge from the physics rather than from thresholds.
   - Input is pointer-locked grips with 1:1 push and roll, pinning keys, independent fluoro and cine pedals, and optional gamepad, MIDI or HID foot switches.
   - The screen shows only what a real lab shows: live and reference monitors, haemodynamic monitor, dose panel and table view.
   - An attending mentor fades as the trainee earns entrustment, in teach, supervised, solo and exam modes. It uses PEARLS debriefs with deterministic replay and rewind-to-decision-point. Assessment is proficiency-based against cited benchmarks (Jensen 2016), and progression is EPA entrustment with spaced skill cards. XP, levels and streaks are removed.

**Phasing.**
- Wave 1 lays foundations in parallel: the realism harness, the projection fix, clock and contracts, the detector and processing chain, the segment integrator, heart motion and shape, coronary morphology, thorax background, the rod core, the input layer, and the reading-drill fixes.
- Wave 2 assembles them: scene and contrast transport, dose and ADRC, the patient engine, the lab shell and imaging workflow, the mentor and telemetry, and entrustment.
- Wave 3 delivers the full procedure: PCI equipment, wire, physiology, IVUS and complications; the team and audio; and the continuous case session from access to closure.

**Budget.** 15 frames/s (66.7 ms) on a laptop integrated GPU. Targets are GPU at most about 25 ms at 768-1024 px, main-thread CPU at most 15 ms (the integrator removes the current 7-11 ms buildTubes cost), and the physics worker at most 8 ms per frame. Each new pass is timed with EXT_disjoint_timer_query.

**Deferred.** Multi-view 3D reconstruction of real trees from CoronaryDominance, and a learned residual realism network, wait until the harness shows a remaining gap after the physical chain is fitted.

**No-git workflow.** Each stream writes only the files it owns. The integrator applies the listed shared-file edits serially at the end of each wave, after a dated copy of the project has been taken.

tasks.title: Port the audit measurement scripts into the repo and generate the targets file
tasks.detail:
Copy and clean the scratch scripts from /private/tmp/claude-502/cathmaster-research/ into scripts/realism/. Sources: imlib, noise2, noisebin, settle, edge2, vessel, cath, texture, xtrack, timing, ridge, field, plus m3_noise, m4_motion, m5_contrast, m7_pct and the anatomy trace/track/spectrum tools.

- Use Python stdlib plus sips only, reusing scripts/angio_library/common.py read_png_gray.
- Keep two explicit pipelines and tag every target with its pipeline, because the audits' absolute noise numbers differ by method:
  - 'lossless': Azurion npz and CADICA PNG.
  - 'matched': 512 px plus JPEG q72 round trip.
- Group targets per vendor profile (azurion, siemens, allura) and per view family.
- Write datasets/library/realism_targets.json as {metric, pipeline, profile, view, median, iqr, band, source_runs}.
tasks.acceptance: run_all.sh on the library reproduces the audit medians within 5%. Examples: Azurion temporal noise SD 3.28, dark/bright ratio 1.13, lung band RMS 8.7, timing rise 19 frames.
tasks.verify: Run bash scripts/realism/run_all.sh --library-only and diff the output against the audit values listed in measurementTargets.

tasks.title: Deterministic offscreen capture hook
tasks.detail:
src/dev/xrayCapture.ts runs in development builds only (import.meta.env.DEV) and defines window.__xrayCapture(spec).

- spec: {caseId, scenario, laoRao, cranCaud, fieldMm, mode:'cine'|'fluoro', fps, nFrames, seed, injection, heartRate, profile}.
- It owns its own OffscreenCanvas, XrayRenderer and buildXrayScene and advances a fixed dt of 1/fps without requestAnimationFrame. This also fixes the hidden-pane rAF pause noted in memory.
- It returns PNG blobs.
- scripts/realism/capture.html drives a list of specs and POSTs the frames to scripts/realism/serve.py (localhost only), which writes datasets/tmp/captures/<spec-hash>/fNNN.png.
tasks.acceptance: Two captures with the same spec and seed are byte-identical. Frame timestamps are exactly k/fps. The project's lab components need no edits.
tasks.verify: Capture the same spec twice and compare SHA-256 sums. Capture LAD RAO caudal at 15 fps and confirm 15 frames/s spacing in metadata.

tasks.title: Realism scorecard
tasks.detail:
scripts/realism/report.py runs every metric on the latest captures for the 5 reference views:
- LAD RAO caudal, AP cranial and LAO cranial
- RCA LAO and RAO

It writes datasets/tmp/realism_report.json with value, band and pass for each metric, plus a terminal table. Captures are taken after the S1 sign fix, so view labels are correct.
tasks.acceptance: The scorecard runs in under 5 minutes and reports every metric in measurementTargets with pass/fail. The baseline run reproduces the audit's renderer numbers, for example lung band RMS 2.7-4.8 and noise dark/bright ratio 2.5-2.8.
tasks.verify: Run on the current build and compare with the audit renderer values.

tasks.title: CPU realism gates in vitest
tasks.detail:
src/render/xray/realism.test.ts calls buildXrayScene headless, with no GL, and projects coronary samples with XrayRenderer.project to check:
- the cranial sign: a cranialCaudal>0 detector has y>0
- motion range and step distribution of the LAD and RCA mid-segments over 3 beats, in px at a 512 equivalent with 0.25 mm/px
- contrast arrival and rise from the summed iodine integral against the timing bands
- catheter-tip cardiac excursion

Tests start as it.todo with thresholds recorded. Each owning stream flips its test to active when its task lands.
tasks.acceptance: The suite exists with thresholds from measurementTargets. Active tests pass in CI (npm test).

tasks.title: Real-or-simulated two-choice drill
tasks.detail:
RealOrSimDrill.tsx pairs a real CoronaryDominance run (frames plus index.json angles) with a simulated run rendered through __xrayCapture-equivalent offscreen code at the same primary and secondary angles and the same artery.

- The two clips play side by side in random order and the user picks the real one.
- The results log (per-view accuracy and reaction time) is stored in localStorage, wrapped in try/catch, and exportable as JSON.
tasks.acceptance: The drill works for LCA and RCA views. Accuracy is reported per view family. The project success criterion is about 50% correct for experienced readers, with the 95% CI including 50%.

streams.title: Foundations: projection convention, cardiac clock, respiration, session contracts
streams.goal: Fix the inverted cranial/caudal geometry before any view-dependent calibration. Provide one CardiacClock and a respiration model shared by the image, ECG, pressure and audio. Define the typed contracts other streams code against.

src/ui/sim/FluoroView.tsx (owner S10): confirm the 2D overlay and view trainer go through cameraBasis; no change expected
docs/SIM_FACTS.md: add sourced entries for respiration excursion (Boussuges 2009) and the cardiac phase-timing model, marked as model parameters

tasks.title: Fix the cranial/caudal sign in cameraBasis
tasks.detail:
In projection.ts cameraBasis, set n.y = +cos(th)*sin(ph) and keep the right/up derivation. makeCamera and coneBeamCamera inherit the fix. DICOM 0018,1511 defines +90 as cranial.

Add tests:
1. cranialCaudal=+30 puts the detector at y>0.
2. The AP cranial projected LAD length exceeds AP caudal (the audit measured 125 vs 134 mm with the sign inverted).
3. The left diaphragm dome top projects higher relative to the heart centre in cranial than in caudal.

Afterwards, list every consumer for the integrator: viewPresets, the FluoroView overlay, ViewTrainer, the AEC path formula.
tasks.acceptance: All three tests pass. The 'LAO CRA' preset renders a long LAD down the middle with diaphragm overlap, matching real cdm-00893-LCA-4.
tasks.verify: npx vitest run src/simulation/projection.test.ts. Visual check: capture LAO 22/CRA 22 via __xrayCapture and compare against a library montage of LAO cranial runs.

tasks.title: Re-base view presets on real operator angles
tasks.detail:
Set viewPresets.ts to the median angles measured from CoronaryDominance:

| View | Angles |
|---|---|
| RCA LAO | LAO 26, CRA 0 (was LAO 40) |
| Spider | LAO 26, CAU 27 |
| LAO cranial | LAO 22, CRA 22 |
| RAO cranial | RAO 27, CRA 24 |
| RAO caudal | RAO 24, CAU 19 |
| AP cranial | LAO 3, CRA 29 |

Store each view's IQR, so the mentor can accept an operator window rather than an exact preset. Presets become C-arm memories that S10 drives to, not teleports.
tasks.acceptance: Each preset is within 2 degrees of the measured median, and each IQR is stored.
tasks.verify: Unit test comparing the preset table with the values above.

tasks.title: CardiacClock
tasks.detail:
cardiacClock.ts exports createClock(params) and the step function step(dtMs) -> {tMs, beatIndex, beatPhase, rrMs, phase:'ivc'|'ejection'|'ivr'|'rapidFill'|'diastasis'|'atrial', phaseFrac, respPhase}.

- Systolic intervals stay near constant across heart rate, while diastasis absorbs RR changes (Husmann 2007: heart rate shortens systole and diastole non-proportionally).
- RR variability and respiratory sinus arrhythmia coupling.
- Hooks for ectopics and an AV-block schedule, so the rhythm engine can inject beats.
- Durations are model parameters, fitted in S3a to the library motion and recorded in SIM_FACTS.

One clock instance per session is passed to sceneBuilder, the ECG, pressure, audio and telemetry.
tasks.acceptance: At 60, 72 and 90 bpm, systole duration varies by less than 15% while diastasis shrinks monotonically. Same seed gives the same beat sequence.

tasks.title: Respiration and breath-hold model
tasks.detail:
respiration.ts holds per-patient rate, tidal diaphragm excursion sampled at or above normal lower limits (quiet breathing about 0.9 cm in women and 1.0 cm in men; deep 3.7/4.7 cm; Boussuges 2009), breath-to-breath variability, and states free | inspire-hold | expire-hold | release.

- Commands take effect after a reaction delay.
- The hold drifts slowly.
- Heart displacement is linear in diaphragm SI motion (Wang 1995), plus small patient AP/LR terms and a rotation about the LR axis. The root stays partly tethered (Shechter 2006: breathing motion is more complex than a translation).

This replaces the constant breathHold 0.7 and the 7 mm excursion in sceneBuilder.
tasks.acceptance: Quiet excursion is at least 9 mm. An inspiration-hold command moves the diaphragm caudally within the configured delay, and drift during the hold stays below 3 mm over 5 s.
tasks.verify: Unit tests in clock.test.ts. After S5 integration, the global-motion statistic (motion2 method) gives sustained cine motion in roughly 9-21% of free-breathing Philips-like runs.

tasks.title: Session contracts
tasks.acceptance: tsc --noEmit passes under strict. Every wave-2 stream imports only these types for cross-stream data.

streams.title: Detector, processing chain and shader slots (XrayRenderer owner)
streams.goal: Replace the ad hoc noise, unsharp mask, DRC and vignette with a measured detector stage and multi-scale processing per vendor-like profile. Also expose the extension slots other streams plug into.

src/render/xray/pyramid.ts (new: Laplacian pyramid, band gains, coring, LUT)

Default cine counts x3 (1500 to 4500) until ADRC (S6) supplies counts.

tasks.title: Extension slots for other streams
tasks.detail:
Refactor XrayRenderer.ts so that:
- ANAT_FS concatenates CLUTTER_GLSL and a clutter() call imported from src/render/xray/clutter.ts (owned by S4; S2 ships a stub returning 0).
- BONE_FS concatenates TRABECULAR_GLSL from the same file.
- render() calls segmentPass.draw(accTarget) and thinPass.draw(accTarget) from src/render/xray/segments/ (owned by S2b; stubs that no-op), before TRANS_FS.
- A velocity texture (RG16F) is allocated and bound for the recursive filter.
- buildTubes is retained behind a flag until S2b lands.
tasks.acceptance: With stubs in place, output is bit-identical to the current build. Each slot is documented in a header comment.
tasks.verify: Capture 5 views before and after via __xrayCapture and check per-pixel equality.

tasks.title: Detector stage: hashed noise, MTF, grey-independent floor
tasks.detail:
Delete vnoise and the textureLod(uTrans, uv, 0.85) read. At detector resolution:
1. Quanta N = Phi0 x fluence x (Tp + S) x eta.
2. White Gaussian z from an integer PCG3D hash of (pixel.x, pixel.y, frame), uvec arithmetic in GLSL ES 3.00.
3. N' = N + sqrt(N) z.
4. A separable Gaussian MTF, 7 taps per axis, applied to signal and noise together, with sigma about 0.16 mm at the detector (Gaussian fit to Azurion MTF(1 lp/mm)=59%). sigmaX and sigmaY are separate.
5. Additive electronic noise in quanta units.
6. A spatially correlated grey-independent floor, sigma about 2.8 grey levels at a 512 equivalent (sigma_L = 2.8*uWindow/255), so bright lung is no longer too clean.

Tune per profile against the lossless targets.
tasks.acceptance:
All on the lossless Azurion-profile pipeline:
- dark/bright temporal noise SD ratio 1.1-1.3 (now 2.5-2.8)
- per-pixel-phase variance 0.93-1.06 of the mean (now 0.58-1.54)
- lag-1 autocorrelation 0.30 (0.16-0.54), lag-2 about -0.05
- temporal SD median 3.3 (2.5-3.9)
- the 160-191 grey bin at 2.1-4.5

Fluoro detector noise is higher than cine at the same grey level.
tasks.verify: scripts/realism noise2.py and noisebin.py on captures. Phase-variance test: render the same scene with two seeds, take the difference, and group variance by (x mod 4, y mod 4).

tasks.title: Vendor-like processing profiles
tasks.detail:
systemProfiles.ts defines generic profiles named by behaviour, not brand: 'cardiac-fp-A' (fitted to the CoronaryDominance Azurion statistics), 'cardiac-fp-B' (CADICA Siemens statistics) and 'cardiac-fp-C' (Allura statistics).

Each profile sets:
- floor SD and noise pre-filter: A is a slight 3x3 sharpen for the lag-2 -0.05 lobe; B is a 3x3 Gaussian low-pass, SD about 2.0, lag-1 0.575; C is white, SD about 5
- recursion weight
- band gains
- the LUT
- the field-edge model

No vendor names or UI are copied.
tasks.acceptance: Each profile matches its source dataset's noise SD and lag-1/lag-2 within the IQR on the matching pipeline.
tasks.verify: noise2.py on captures per profile against realism_targets.json.

tasks.title: Multi-scale processing: harmonisation, halo, coring, S-LUT
tasks.detail:
pyramid.ts builds a 6-level Burt-Adelson Laplacian pyramid of log transmission, using separable 5-tap binomial down and up passes.

- Per-band gains uBandGain[6]. Low bands below 1 replace uDrc (harmonisation). A mid-band gain reproduces the large-border shoulder. Bands 1-2 get edge boost.
- Noise-adaptive soft-threshold coring of bands 0-1 at k x sigma, with sigma known from N.
- A 256-entry S-shaped LUT texture.
- The noise texture stays on the noisy L path, so the grain set in the detector task is preserved.

The mip-chain reads at LOD 2.2, 5.2 and 5.5 are removed.
tasks.acceptance: Large borders show a bright-side rise of 5-14 grey levels over about 20 px and a drop of 20-26 levels over about 6 px (heart border and diaphragm, edge2.py). Local-contrast p99 pre-contrast is about 30.8 (LCA, matched pipeline). The noise power spectrum shape stays within 2 percentage points per band of the pre-change capture.
tasks.verify: edge2.py and localcontrast.py on captures. noise2.py for the NPS.

tasks.title: Auto-window from a histogram with one-frame latency
tasks.detail:
Scatter mip-4 pixels into a 64-bin histogram target with additive blending, using a point-sprite vertex shader. Read it back asynchronously with a PBO plus fenceSync, one frame late.

Set window and level so p5, p50 and p95 hit the profile targets. Smooth with a first-order lag of about 3 frames. The same readback supplies the metering value (getMeter()) for S6.
tasks.acceptance: Philips-like p5 is 93-98 in every view family (now 74-131). p50 is 129-145 and p95 is 196-219 per view, within plus or minus 6 levels. LAO cranial is no longer 20-33 levels too light. Validate after the S1 sign fix.
tasks.verify: pct.py on captures for RAO cranial, RAO caudal, LAO cranial, LAO caudal, AP cranial and RCA LAO.

tasks.title: Motion-compensated, motion-adaptive recursive filter
tasks.detail:
Sample the previous frame at uv - v*dt, using the velocity texture (written by S2b for segments, and analytically from heartMotion for anatomy borders).

Set k = rec x exp(-((g - prev_mc)/(c x sigma))^2). Cine rec is about 0.12; fluoro rec comes from the profile.
tasks.acceptance: Steady-state frame-to-frame noise correlation is 0.08 (-0.08 to 0.17). On a vessel moving at least 6 px/frame, the trailing ghost residual is below 1 x noise SD.
tasks.verify: The noise2.py temporal-correlation statistic, plus a ghost metric script (mean difference behind the moving edge) on fluoro captures with rec 0.5.

tasks.title: Field geometry, shutters, wedges, scatter and grid
tasks.detail:
Field geometry:
- Remove vig = 1 - 0.10 r^2 (keep at most 0.03 r^2).
- Replace step(...,0.985) with a smoothstep over about 3% of the width and a superellipse corner mask.
- Profile A: an outer rim 2 px about 8 levels darker. Profile B: a soft 16 px dark frame with rounded corners.

Fluence map in TRANS_FS:
- Phi(x) = prod over blades of erfc((n.x - e)/(sqrt(2) sigma_pen)) x exp(-mu_wedge x w(x)).
- The shutter penumbra is 4-8 px. Wedges are rotatable semi-transparent half-planes with about a 3 px edge.

Scatter:
- Use kernel superposition on pyramid levels 3-6.
- SPR comes from the water-equivalent thickness (soft-tissue channel), the collimated area from Phi, and a grid-in/grid-out transmission.
- Fit SPR jointly with catheter depth.
tasks.acceptance: Edge-band means (field.py), profile A: 0-2 px about 137, 2-4 px about 141, 8-16 px about 145, with no black border. Profile B: 0-2 px about 78 and 16-32 px about 132. Collimating reduces scatter and raises local contrast. Unfilled catheter depth (matched pipeline) has a median of about 40 levels (real 22-54).
tasks.verify: field.py and cath.py on captures. A unit test that a shutter halving the field reduces the mean scatter term.

tasks.title: Resolution and frame budget
tasks.detail:
Render at device-pixel resolution up to 1024 squared and present with a Lanczos downscale.

renderer.perf.ts wraps every pass in EXT_disjoint_timer_query and logs a per-pass budget table. If an integrated GPU exceeds 25 ms, it falls back to 768 automatically.
tasks.acceptance: At 1024 squared, total GPU time is at most 8 ms on the M4. Extrapolated time stays under 25 ms on a GPU 3-4 times slower. 15 fps holds in AngioPci with the PCI scenario.
tasks.verify: renderer.perf.ts timing report. FPS counter over 60 s of cine in the dev build.

tasks.title: Spectral material decomposition (late wave-2 task)
tasks.detail:
The anatomy, bone and segment passes write path lengths to two RGBA32F MRT targets:
- MRT0: soft tissue, lung deficit, cortical bone, adipose.
- MRT1: iodine mg/mL.mm, Pt-Ir, CoCr/steel, W/Ta.

Require EXT_color_buffer_float and EXT_float_blend, with an RGBA16F fallback.

spectral.ts:
- builds a 16-bin spectrum per frame from kVp, Cu and Al supplied by ADRC
- uses mu(E) tables from NIST (cited URLs in code comments) and CsI detector weights
- computes T = sum of w_E S_E exp(-sum mu_m L_m) in TRANS_FS

This replaces the (75/kV)^2.2 and (75/kV)^1.4 gains.
tasks.acceptance: Effective iodine attenuation falls 20-30% between the entrance and 300 mm of tissue (model check). Platinum marker contrast stays flat from 85 to 105 kVp. Bone excess falls with kV. GPU cost is at most 0.5 ms on the M4.
tasks.verify: A unit test of spectral.ts against the audit's model numbers. Visual: marker contrast versus kV sweep.

streams.title: Analytic vessel and device integrator
streams.goal: Replace CPU ribbon tubes for iodine, catheter, wire and devices with a GPU round-cone union integrator and a PSF-consistent thin-object pass. This removes double counting, square caps, the 1.25 px hack and 7-11 ms of CPU work per frame.
touchesSharedFiles: src/render/xray/sceneBuilder.ts (owner S5): emit segments via tubesToSegments(tubes) and ThinPrim[] for devices, in place of iodine/metal TubeSpec; provide previous-frame sample positions for velocity
src/render/xray/XrayRenderer.ts (owner S2): slot calls already added by S2 task 1

tasks.title: Segment packing and tile binning
tasks.detail:
Segments are packed into an RGBA32F texture, 3 texels per segment:
- (p0.xyz, r0)
- (p1.xyz, r1)
- (c0, c1, materialId, treeId)

They are filled directly from vessel sample arrays, with no CPU projection or decimation.

CPU binning projects each capsule's bounds, plus a 3-sigma PSF margin and a motion margin, onto 16x16 px tiles. Output is an R32UI offset/count texture and a flat R32UI index list. The audit measured 8-10 segments per covered tile, a p95 of 19-25 and a maximum of 40-60.
tasks.acceptance: Binning of 1,500 segments takes at most 1.5 ms CPU. A brute-force test finds 0 pixels missing a segment that covers them.
tasks.verify: segments.test.ts: compare against brute-force coverage on random scenes. Time with performance.now.

tasks.title: SEG_FS exact round-cone union
tasks.detail:
For each pixel, build the ray from the source to the detector point and solve the closed-form ray vs tapered-capsule intersection for each segment in the tile.

- Push (tin, tout, c, mat) into a local array of 24 entries.
- Insertion-sort the entries, then sweep-merge per tree id, taking max(c) inside overlaps. This gives a true union with no double counting at branch origins.
- Write iodine and metal path lengths into the accumulation target.
- Where the minimum projected radius is under 1.5 px, use 4 rotated-grid rays per pixel.
- Use a hollow-tube material for catheters (outer minus inner capsule) so the tram-track lumen appears.
tasks.acceptance: The iodine integral across a bifurcation origin is at most the maximum parent or child chord plus 1%, with no dark dot. An end-on segment renders as a round disc with the correct path. Unfilled catheter lumen is 13-25 levels lighter than the walls, and outer FWHM is 7-9.75 px (cath.py). GPU time is at most 1 ms on the M4. buildTubes is deleted.
tasks.verify: segments.test.ts with analytic chord cases. cath.py and vessel.py on captures. Visual check of LCx in LAO cranial for square caps.

tasks.title: Laminar front and streaming concentration inside the lumen
tasks.detail:
Concentration is c(s, rho, t) = c_bulk(s,t) x [1 + a_mix(s) n(s - v t)] x (1 - k(t) rho^2/R^2).

- The closed-form chord is 2h(1 - k(d^2 + h^2/3)/R^2), with h = sqrt(R^2 - d^2).
- n is a 1D advected noise texture.
- a_mix, k and the streaming radius fraction are per-segment parameters supplied by S5's transport.
tasks.acceptance: Together with the S2 MTF, vessel profile shape w80/w20 has a median of about 0.43 (0.34-0.51, now 0.48-0.61). Proximal vessel depth at full opacification is about 57-59 levels (single-run indicator).
tasks.verify: vessel.py on proximal LM/LAD segments of RAO caudal captures.

tasks.title: Intra-pulse motion blur and velocity buffer
tasks.detail:
Upload a second endpoint set at t +/- PW/2, with pulse width from ADRC (default 8 ms until S6 lands).

- In tiles where |v| x PW exceeds 0.5 px, integrate 3 temporal sub-samples.
- For opaque devices, average the transmission factor rather than the path length.
- Write screen velocity (RG16F) for S2's motion-compensated recursion.
tasks.acceptance: On the fastest RCA segments, measured blur is 1.2-2.5 px at 512 (the audit's estimate from 6-12.5 ms pulses). GPU cost is at most 1 ms extra.
tasks.verify: Compare edge 10-90% widths of the RCA mid-segment at systole and diastole in captures (vessel.py).

tasks.title: Thin-object pass for struts, markers, coils and hardware
tasks.detail:
thinLut.ts precomputes a 64x32 RG16F LUT of the cylinder chord mu x 2sqrt(r^2 - d^2), convolved with a Gaussian of sigma_tot = sqrt(sigma_MTF^2 + sigma_focal(z)^2 + sigma_motion^2). sigma_focal = f x (SID - d)/d for a 0.5 or 0.8 mm focal spot (Azurion spec).

ThinPrim {p0, p1, r, mu, material} is drawn as camera-facing quads of half-width 3 sigma_tot + r, reading the LUT at the exact sub-pixel distance.

The API is consumed by S14 (stent struts, markers, wire coils) and S4 (sternal wires, ECG leads).
tasks.acceptance: A straight 0.014-inch wire (about 1.6 px) shows less than 2% integral variation along its length, so no beading. 2,000 primitives cost at most 0.3 ms GPU on the M4.
tasks.verify: segments.test.ts LUT integral test. Wire capture profile along its length.

streams.title: Heart motion field and shared heart shape
streams.goal: Make cardiac motion physiologically correct in sign, amplitude, distribution and timing, and drive the root, ostia and catheter. Make the rendered heart silhouette the same deforming surface the coronaries sit on.
touchesSharedFiles: src/render/xray/sceneBuilder.ts (owner S5): replace contraction(phase) with heartMotion.sample(clockState); apply heartMotion.rootDisplacement(t) to rootW samples and, decaying with arc length from the tip, to catheter nodes in moveWorld
src/render/xray/thorax.ts (owner S4): buildThorax(opts) accepts heartPrims: AnalyticPrim[] = heartShape.fit(clockState) in place of fixed HEART/HEART_FAT/RVOT/LA/RA ellipsoids

tasks.title: Time-based heart motion field
tasks.detail:
heartMotion.ts defines u(ell, phi, h, t) as the sum of:
- longitudinal base descent, fading towards the apex
- twist with the correct sign: apex anticlockwise about 9-10 degrees and base clockwise about 4-7 degrees, viewed from the apex (Cheng 2017; Buckberg 2011), scaled by contractility
- radial thickening
- whole-heart translation towards left, inferior and anterior (Shechter 2006)
- an acute-margin lateral swing
- regional phase lags, with the RV and RCA leading

The waveform follows CardiacClock phases: isovolumic contraction, ejection, isovolumic relaxation, rapid filling with fast return, a diastasis that shrinks with heart rate, and an atrial kick.

surfacePoint() in heart.ts calls it. The current 12% descent, 5% radial and 8 degree twist with the wrong sign are replaced.

Fit amplitudes with xtrack.py and the anatomy track tools on captures against the library.
tasks.acceptance:
Twist-sign test: the apex rotates anticlockwise viewed from the apex.

Projected motion at a 512-equivalent scale:

| Vessel | Range | Step median | Step p90 | Step max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LAD | 16-31 px | 2-3.2 | 4.3-8.8 | ≤11 px/frame |
| RCA | 28-46 px | 2.7-9 | 8.3-12.2 | ≤14.2 |

- RCA/LAD in-plane amplitude ratio is 1.6-3 (real 2.2; 17.8 vs 8.2 mm).
- The still fraction falls as heart rate rises.
- The block-matching median is about 5 px/frame at 15 fps (now 0-1).
tasks.verify: heartMotion.test.ts for sign, ratio and still fraction. xtrack.py and blockmotion.py on __xrayCapture LAD RAO caudal, AP cranial and RCA LAO runs.

tasks.title: Root, ostium and catheter coupling
tasks.detail:
Export rootDisplacement(t) for the annulus and aortic root, and catheterTether(sFromTip), the coupling decay along the shaft.

The proximal coronary (w<1) samples and the rod lumen of the aortic root (S7) move with it. The catheter tip then bobs at the ostium, and engagement sees relative motion.
tasks.acceptance: Catheter shaft above the ostium shows a periodic lateral range of about 15 px and a maximum step of about 5.3 px/frame (now 4 px, aperiodic). Proximal landmarks move 6-25 mm.
tasks.verify: xtrack.py on a catheter scan line in RCA LAO captures.

tasks.title: Shared deforming heart shape
tasks.detail:
heartShape.ts defines a parametric biventricular surface whose epicardium coincides with surfacePoint:
- LV truncated prolate spheroid
- RV crescent
- RVOT and PA trunk
- RA/RAA and LA/LAA
- aortic root

It carries groove curves for S3b.

Each frame, deform the surface with heartMotion and fit 8-12 ellipsoids or capsules by small CPU least squares (or precomputed per-phase tables), so the exact-interval shader and its budget are unchanged.

The uniform HEART_FAT halo becomes a 2-4 mm epicardial fat shell, with AV-groove and cardiophrenic fat pads.
tasks.acceptance: Projected obtuse- and acute-margin arteries lie within 2-3 mm of the silhouette in RAO, LAO and AP views (now 8-12 mm inside or 9 mm outside). The silhouette border moves with the beat. The fit costs at most 0.5 ms CPU.
tasks.verify: heartMotion.test.ts consistency test (ray from the long axis through vessel samples against fitted primitives). Visual against a library frame such as cdm-00909-LCA-2.

tasks.title: Heart size and orientation parameters
tasks.detail: Change makeHeart(scale, axis:{azimuth, elevation, roll}, shapeModes) so it is driven by the genome (sex/BSA scale, horizontal heart with large habitus, cardiomegaly, LVH).
tasks.acceptance: Projected LCA extents per view fall within real IQRs, for example RAO caudal about 101x98 mm and AP cranial about 94x93 mm (now 84x91 and 74x115). Projected LM+LAD length in RAO cranial is about 96-136 mm (now 144).
tasks.verify: Projected-extent test over 50 genomes in heartMotion.test.ts.

tasks.title: Myocardial bridge compression function
tasks.detail: Export bridgeCompression(phase) for S3b's bridge variant, giving systolic narrowing (milking) tied to the motion waveform.
tasks.acceptance: Function returns 0 in diastole and its maximum in systole. Unit-tested.

streams.title: Coronary tree morphology, variability and calibres
streams.goal: Replace the fixed schematic tree with seeded, population-sampled anatomy. Fix the proximal kinks, add real tortuosity and branch density, and size calibres by flow. Keep the TreeVessel API stable for lesions, PCI and collaterals.
touchesSharedFiles: src/types/index.ts (owner S1): AnatomyVariant gains 'anomalous-lcx-right-sinus', 'anomalous-rca-left-sinus', 'myocardial-bridge', 'prior-cabg'
src/simulation/engagement.ts (owner S7): read ostium positions from anatomy.ts; no logic change

tasks.title: Proximal course and ostia
tasks.detail:
Define the AV groove as an explicit 3D closed ring (mitral plus tricuspid annulus) wrapping behind and below the aortic root, and the interventricular grooves as surface curves.

- LAD originates in the AIV groove at or below LM height.
- LCx runs in the left AV groove under the LAA.
- The Hermite bridge is replaced by a curvature-limited spline that leaves along the ostial direction and is monotone in height.
- The RCA runs in the right AV groove with no straight stub.
- In anatomy.ts the RCA ostium sits higher than the LM ostium (Philip 2015).
tasks.acceptance: Maximum height over the first 20 mm of LAD and LCx is at most the bifurcation plus 3 mm (now +14.5 and +11.1 mm). LCx arc/chord in RAO caudal is under 1.6 (now 7.5). The proximal LAD has no Z-kink in any standard view.
tasks.verify: anatomy.test.ts geometric assertions. Visual montage via __xrayCapture against library montages.

tasks.title: Band-limited 3D tortuosity
tasks.detail:
tortuosity.ts produces lateral offsets in the local surface frame (in-surface normal plus the h direction) as three octaves with wavelengths 3-8, 8-20 and 20-60 mm.

- Seeded per patient, with amplitude from a per-patient tortuosity index by vessel class, and an optional helical corkscrew mode.
- Enforce a minimum radius of curvature.
- Ostia and stented segments stay straighter.
- Arc length is preserved, so lesion pathMm does not drift.
tasks.acceptance: Projected 8-20 mm band tangent-angle RMS is 6-22 degrees with a median of about 11 (now 1.2-2.1). The 3-8 mm band is 9-19 degrees (now 0.2-0.9). Lesion pathMm drift is under 0.5 mm.
tasks.verify: scripts/anatomy_validation/spectrum.mjs on sim projections. anatomy.test.ts drift test.

tasks.title: AnatomyGenome from cited priors
tasks.detail:
coronaryAtlas.ts implements sampleGenome(seed). Each prior is commented with its DOI:
- dominance right/left/co 81.2/9.1/9.7% (Knaapen 2012)
- ramus about 30% (Medrano-Gracia 2017)
- diagonals single/double/multiple 14/62/24% and marginals 20/51/29% (Manpoong 2023)
- wrap-around LAD (Manpoong 2023; Ilia 2014 range)
- SA-nodal artery from the RCA 68.0%, LCx 22.1%, duplicated 4.3% (Vikse 2016)
- myocardial bridging 6% at angiography, 82% on the LAD, mean length 19.3 mm (Hostiuc 2018)
- LM length 10.5±5.3 mm and LMB angle 75±23 / 89±21 degrees (Medrano-Gracia 2016)
- sex -9% calibre and LVH +17% (Dodge 1992)

The genome is derived from the case id, so caseGenerator needs no edit. It is stored on the built tree so teaching text can state 'ramus present, wrap-around LAD'.
tasks.acceptance: Over 1,000 sampled genomes, every categorical frequency is within 2 percentage points of its prior. LAD projected length across 8 seeds now spans a realistic range rather than 156.2-157.1 mm.

tasks.title: Territory-guided growth to realistic branch density
tasks.detail:
coronaryGrowth.ts routes named branches as geodesics on the heart surface towards territory attractors:
- diagonals to the anterolateral wall
- septals into the septal plane
- OMs along the obtuse margin
- RV branches across the RV free wall
- the PDA in the posterior interventricular groove, with inferior septals
- PLV branches
- the AV-nodal U-turn at the crux
- the SA-nodal branch towards the SVC-RA junction

Space colonisation constrained to the epicardium and septum then fills 2-3 more generations, down to about 0.4 mm radius. This removes the 22-24 parallel twig 'comb'. Each tip tapers to 0.1-0.15 mm radius with an iodine fade over the last samples.
tasks.acceptance: Peak opacified area (pixels more than 10 levels below baseline, central 76%) reaches 16-34% (real median 22.5%; now 5.6-6.9%), measured jointly with S2 processing. Mid-tree transect crossings have medians of about 8/7/4 in RAO cranial, AP cranial and LAO cranial. The smallest visible branches have FWHM 2.0-3.2 px and depth 8-27 levels.
tasks.verify: scripts/realism timing.py area metric and the anatomy transect2 tool on captures. Visual montage.

tasks.title: Huo-Kassab calibre law
tasks.detail:
Terminal branches are weighted by territory mass and flows accumulated to the root, with D proportional to Q^(3/7) (Gong 2016, Huo-Kassab).

- Downstream of each side branch, D_main = (D_parent^(7/3) - D_side^(7/3))^(3/7).
- The LM is scaled to Dodge values (4.5±0.5 mm), adjusted for sex and LVH, and LCx is about 4.2 mm when left-dominant.
- Lesions, stents and occlusions stay multiplicative modifiers.
tasks.acceptance: The Finet ratio distribution of normal bifurcations lies mostly below 0.678 (Finet 2008; Medrano-Gracia 2017). There are no bifurcations with a Murray cube ratio above 1.2 (now 1.43-1.70).

tasks.title: Variants and anomalies as geometry
tasks.detail:
Map each variant to geometry:
- separate ostia: LCx from leftOstium2 with its own trunk
- shepherd's crook RCA: a superior proximal loop
- tortuous RCA: a high tortuosity index
- myocardial bridge: a 15-25 mm mid-LAD segment at h<0 with radius x (1 - bridgeCompression(phase))
- anomalous LCx from the right sinus or RCA
- RCA from the left sinus with an interarterial course

anatomy.ts exports matching engagement targets for S7.
tasks.acceptance: Each variant changes the rendered tree, checked by a snapshot of projected geometry per variant. The bridge shows systolic narrowing on cine.

tasks.title: Adaptive centreline resampling at lesions
tasks.detail: Insert samples at each lesion centre and wherever |dr/ds| or curvature is high, so spacing is at most 0.25 mm within plus or minus the lesion length (now 1.84-2.22 mm median). Segment radii are interpolated linearly by S2b.
tasks.acceptance: A nominal 90% lesion renders an MLD within 2% of the specified value (now about 81% read).

streams.title: Thorax background: lung clutter, bones, mediastinum and hardware
streams.goal: Give the pre-contrast background the measured lung texture, thin cortical rib and vertebral lines, a lobulated beating silhouette, per-patient thorax variation, and the hardware real cines contain.
touchesSharedFiles: src/render/xray/sceneBuilder.ts (owner S5): pass patientSeed, habitus, heartPrims and hardware list into buildThorax and the device/extras list
src/simulation/caseGenerator.ts (owner S9): optional case flags priorCabg and pacemaker, with probabilities as parameters

tasks.title: Statistically matched 3D lung and soft-tissue clutter
tasks.detail:
clutter_stats.py measures per-tissue radial power spectra and anisotropy (lung, mediastinum, liver/diaphragm, spine) from pre-contrast library frames 1-3. Only statistics are kept, never patient pixels.

clutter.ts synthesises tileable random-phase 3D Gaussian random fields (64^3-128^3 R16F) whose spectra reproduce those statistics, plus ridged multi-octave noise 1-|2n-1| at 2-10 mm for filamentary markings.

In CLUTTER_GLSL, ANAT_FS ray-marches 8-16 taps inside the lung and soft-tissue intervals, in lung-local coordinates that stretch with respiration. Amplitude is weighted by chord length and calibrated per tissue.
tasks.acceptance:
All measured on pre-contrast frames:
- Lung band-pass (4-32 px) RMS is 7.7-14.5 with a median of about 8.7 (now 2.7-4.8).
- Power at 0.125 cycles/px is 205-368 (now 9-23).
- High-band slope is -2.2 to -2.9.
- Spectral slope beta is 2.45-3.11.
- Local-contrast p99 is about 30.8.
- Thin dark-line pixels per frame fall in 10.8k-14.1k.
- A vertical lung profile varies by ±10-25 levels.

GPU cost is at most 1 ms on the M4.
tasks.verify: texture.py, ridge.py and localcontrast.py on pre-contrast captures.

tasks.title: Per-patient pulmonary vascular trees
tasks.detail:
Grow the trees by space colonisation in each lung, 7-8 generations down to a radius of about 0.35-0.4 mm, a few thousand segments in total.

- Seed from the patient, replacing prng(7).
- The trees move with breathing.
- They are continuous with the hilar arteries and PA trunk.
- They render through S2b segments, giving end-on vessel dots.
- Keep LUNG_VESSEL_MU and taper to zero.
tasks.acceptance: End-on dots are visible. Combined with the clutter task, the lung texture targets are met. Segment occupancy stays within the S2b budget (p95 per covered tile at most 32).

tasks.title: Cortical ribs without lattice
tasks.detail:
Ribs get:
- a thin cortical shell with outer minus inner radius of 0.6-1.0 mm and higher cortical excess
- lower marrow-band contrast
- per-rib variation in curvature and width
- posterior ribs denser than anterior
- tapered costal-cartilage ends instead of flat cut ends
tasks.acceptance: Rib margins in lung are 4.0-4.3 px FWHM and 14-29 levels deep. In oblique views the ribs show no basket-weave lattice when compared visually with a library montage.
tasks.verify: vessel.py on hand-traced rib margins in captures. Visual check.

tasks.title: Vertebrae with endplates and ring pedicles
tasks.detail:
Each vertebral body is a waisted cortical shell (two capped cylinders with a narrower middle).

- Dense endplate discs of about 1 mm with rounded rims.
- Disc gaps of 5-8 mm.
- Small per-level rotation and lateral jitter.
- Pedicles as rings (outer minus inner ellipsoid) with strong cortical excess.
- Trabecular 3D noise inside cancellous bone through TRABECULAR_GLSL.
tasks.acceptance: Endplates are 2.5-3.9 px FWHM and 13-24 levels deep with a peaked profile (w80/w20 0.23-0.34). The spine edge is no longer a full-height straight 33-level step.
tasks.verify: vessel.py on AP cranial captures. Visual check in LAO.

tasks.title: Beating lobulated silhouette and great vessels
tasks.detail:
buildThorax consumes heartPrims from S3a every frame and carves the lung with the thin fat shell.

Add:
- aortic arch and descending aorta tubes along aorticCourse
- SVC and IVC
- a PA trunk continuous with the pulmonary trees

Borders are lobulated by the LAA, the epicardial fat pad and the RA.
tasks.acceptance: The heart border moves with the cardiac phase. The heart and diaphragm borders show the S2 halo targets. There is no perfect ellipsoid arc in RAO caudal.

tasks.title: Hardware and environment content
tasks.detail:
hardware.ts returns ThinPrim and segment lists:
- ECG electrode discs with snaps on the chest wall, moving with breathing
- sagging lead-wire catenaries leaving the field
- for post-CABG cases, twisted sternal wire loops and clips along graft courses
- a pacemaker or ICD can with leads into the RV, moving with the heart
- the table edge and mattress

It can be toggled off for teaching. The audit saw sternotomy wires in at least 5 of 36 sampled library frames, so per-case probabilities are parameters.
tasks.acceptance: Each item renders at a plausible contrast through the metal material, and the toggle works.

tasks.title: Per-patient thorax genome
tasks.detail: Habitus 0.85-1.25 scales the body and soft tissue, which drives ADRC kV, noise and dose. It also sets diaphragm height, lung volume and rib-cage shape. Everything is seeded from the case id.
tasks.acceptance: Across 8 seeds, the pre-contrast median grey level and the ADRC kV vary realistically, and no two patients share an identical thorax.

streams.title: Scene assembly and physical contrast transport (sceneBuilder owner)
streams.goal: Assemble the scene from the clock, motion, shape, segments, thorax and profiles. Replace the canned bolus with a hand injection mixing with coronary flow and advected along the tree, so contrast timing, streaming, reflux and washout emerge.
touchesSharedFiles: src/simulation/physiology.ts (owner S9): export coronaryFlow(territoryOrVesselId, beatPhase, patient) and lesion resistance per vessel; read-only use here
src/state/useSimulatorStore.ts (owner S10): inject() no longer starts a fixed bolus; it forwards syringe plunger commands to injection.ts and the transport state into buildXrayScene
src/ui/sections/AngioPci.tsx (owner S10): stop passing injectDur 1.8 s and the fixed 4.2 s cine; pass the transport state

tasks.title: Integrate the new scene inputs
tasks.detail:
buildXrayScene(inp) takes:
- clockState (S1) in place of inp.t*hr/60
- the respiration state (S1)
- heartMotion and rootDisplacement (S3a): moveWorld adds a cardiac term for rootW samples and catheter nodes, decaying from the tip
- heartShape prims into buildThorax
- segments and ThinPrims through tubesToSegments (S2b)
- patientSeed, habitus and hardware (S4)
- the system profile
- framesSinceStart, with run-start settling counts = counts/(1+0.58 e^(-k/3))^2 for cine and for each fluoro pedal-down
- shutters and wedges
- catheter nodes from the physics client when present (S7), falling back to catheterPath otherwise
tasks.acceptance: Run-start noise relative to pairs 9-10 follows 1.48, 1.30, 1.22, 1.16, 1.10, 1.07, 1.05, 1.05, 1.01 within ±0.05. xray.test.ts still passes. The FluoroView default 72 bpm desync is gone because the heart rate comes from the clock.
tasks.verify: settle.py on captures; npx vitest run src/render/xray.

tasks.title: Manifold and syringe model
tasks.detail:
injection.ts defines ManifoldState {tap:'pressure'|'contrast'|'flush'|'waste', syringe {volMl, contrastMl, salineMl, bloodMl, airMl}, lineAirMl}.

- Plunger velocity comes from the S8 grip.
- Injection flow Q_inj is limited by Poiseuille catheter resistance (French size, length, contrast viscosity as a parameter) and by hand force. The resistance is reported back for pseudo-haptics, so 4-5F needs more force (Oxford handbook notes).
- Aspiration returns blood only when the tip is free.
- Drawn air appears as bubbles that must be tilted out. Injected air raises an air-embolism exposure for S14.
- The jet reaction force rho x Q^2/A is output to the rod solver.
- Contrast volume is integrated from what is actually delivered.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests cover the resistance scaling with French size and length, aspiration with tip wedged vs free, and air accounting. The contrast total equals the delivered volume.

tasks.title: 1D advection-dispersion contrast transport
tasks.detail:
contrastTransport.ts runs upwind advection plus Taylor dispersion along each TreeVessel pathMm.

- Inlet concentration is C0 x min(1, Q_inj/(Q_inj + Q_cor x open)), with open being the ostium fraction left open by the catheter (from S7).
- Excess Q_inj - Q_cor x open refluxes to the sinus/root plume.
- Velocity is Q/A(s), using lesion area and phasic flow from physiology.ts, so TIMI-like delay and pulsation emerge.
- Washout comes from coronary flow.
- Per-sample concentration replaces b.peak and injectDur.
- Defaults are calibrated so that a standard expert hand injection (cine pedal pressed about 0.4 s before the push, pedal released by the operator) reproduces the library timing.
- Streaming parameters (a_mix, k, streaming radius) go to S2b.
- Hang-up occurs when the catheter is wedged.
- Myocardial blush is driven by territory perfusion.
tasks.acceptance:
Timing metric (timing.py) on the expert default:
- first appearance (10%) at a median of about 0.40 s after cine start (IQR 0.27-0.67)
- 10-90% rise about 1.27 s (1.0-1.87), with LCA faster than RCA (18 vs 29 frames)
- frames at or above 90% about 5 (4-8)
- 50% washout about 0.67 s after peak
- end of run about 52% of peak (22-63%) when the run stops at about 3.4 s

Other targets:
- Plateau (≥50%, run_analysis metric) varies run to run with injection, covering 0.93-2.27 s.
- Late blush grey change is -0.3 to -4.7.
tasks.verify: timing.py on __xrayCapture runs with scripted injections at three plunger speeds. Unit tests on mass conservation in contrastTransport.

tasks.title: Streaming, reflux and hang-up behaviour
tasks.detail:
Cover the cases where:
- Q_inj < Q_cor gives streaming, with a reduced effective iodine radius and layering
- Q_inj > Q_cor opacifies the cusp, scaled with the excess
- a deep-seated or wedged tip gives no washout and a hang-up warning cue in the image

All of these come from the same transport.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests: a weak injection gives a peak concentration below 60% of a forceful injection's, a forceful injection opacifies the root plume, and a wedged injection shows less than 20% washout over 3 s.

streams.title: Automatic dose-rate control and dose physics
streams.goal: Close the loop from metered transmission to kVp, mA, pulse width and Cu, with limits. Compute Ka,r, KAP, skin and operator dose, so collimation, angulation, pulse rate and habitus have visible and teachable consequences.
touchesSharedFiles: src/render/xray/XrayRenderer.ts (owner S2): getMeter() async readback API from the auto-window task, masked by shutters and direct exposure
src/render/xray/sceneBuilder.ts (owner S5): counts, kVp, Cu, pulseWidthMs and spectrum inputs come from adrc.state instead of the kv = 62 + (path-220)*0.12 formula
src/ui/sim/VitalsMonitor.tsx (owner S9): delete dap = fluoroTime*18 (line ~136)
docs/SIM_FACTS.md: dose model constants and their sources (TG-125, ClarityIQ white paper figures, 21 CFR 1020.32)

tasks.title: Closed-loop ADRC
tasks.detail:
Required exposure = target detector signal / metered transmission, with one frame of readback latency and a first-order lag of 2-3 frames.

- Map exposure onto (kVp, mA, pulse width, Cu) using program curves: fluoro low/normal/high and cine.
- Apply generator, tube and air-kerma-rate limits. FDA limits are 88 mGy/min normal mode and 176 mGy/min high-level mode (TG-125).
- When a limit binds, detector dose and visible noise rise.
- Smaller detector formats raise air kerma to hold noise constant (ClarityIQ white paper).
- Curve shapes follow the TG-125 description and are labelled as model.
tasks.acceptance: Steep LAO cranial and large-habitus projections are noisier once at the limit. Fluoro detector dose per frame is below cine. Pulse width stays within 6-12.5 ms and feeds S2b motion blur.
tasks.verify: dose.test.ts scenarios; noise2.py on thick-projection captures.

tasks.title: Dose quantities and displays
tasks.detail:
For each pulse:
- Ka,r increment at the interventional reference point (inverse square)
- KAP = Ka,r x beam area (collimated)
- fluoro time
- a skin-dose map on a cylindrical back-of-patient grid indexed by beam entrance
- an operator scatter index scaled by projection and shielding toggles

Typical cardiac fluoro patient dose rates are kept within the ranges documented in the ClarityIQ white paper and cited. Trigger levels (Ka,r 5 Gy, KAP 500 Gy cm2, fluoro 60 min; SIM_FACTS item 23) are announced. DosePanel shows Ka,r, KAP and time.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests: collimating to half the area halves KAP per frame, doubling pps doubles fluoro dose rate, and steep angles raise Ka,r. Values are logged to telemetry.

tasks.title: Grid in/out and pulse-rate selection
tasks.detail: Add a grid toggle for the air-gap technique, affecting scatter (S2) and dose. Gridless air-gap angiography lowered DAP in the Heart 2005 study, doi 10.1136/hrt.2005.063909. Fluoro pulse rates are selectable, for example 7.5 and 15 pps.
tasks.acceptance: Grid out lowers dose and changes contrast, and the effect is visible in the scorecard. Debrief shows the dose effect of the trainee's choices.

streams.title: Device physics: catheters and wires as elastic rods
streams.goal: Make catheters, sheaths and wires physical rods in vessel lumens. Engagement, torque wind-up and whip, deep seating, prolapse, backup and wire tracking then emerge from mechanics, not thresholds.
touchesSharedFiles: src/render/xray/sceneBuilder.ts (owner S5): catheter and wire tube points from physicsClient.latestNodes() replace catheterPath()
src/state/useSimulatorStore.ts (owner S10): controls become HandCommand messages to the worker; engagement is read from the classifier
src/render/xray/thorax.ts (owner S4): export aorticCourse as 3D centreline plus radius per route

tasks.title: Discrete Cosserat rod solver in a worker
tasks.detail:
Nodes plus quaternion frames, with XPBD stretch/shear, bend/twist and inextensibility constraints. Each node carries rest curvature and twist, and each device has a bending and torsional stiffness profile (shaft, transition, soft tip).

- Fixed 240 Hz substeps, about 10 iterations, inside physicsWorker.
- Transferable Float32Array output.
- Deterministic given inputs and seed, which the replay needs.
- bench.ts adapts the node count to device speed.

The approach follows VCSim3 (Korzeniowski 2017, inextensible Cosserat rods).
tasks.acceptance: Cantilever tip deflection is within 5% of the analytic value. Torque is transmitted through a curved lumen with a measurable lag. Identical input logs give identical node buffers. Worker time is at most 2 ms per 66.7 ms frame for about 300 nodes on the M4.
tasks.verify: npx vitest run src/physics/rod.test.ts; bench.ts report.

tasks.title: Vessel lumens and contact
tasks.detail:
lumen.ts builds swept-tube signed-distance fields for the radial, brachial, subclavian, arch, ascending aorta and femoral-iliac routes, from aorticCourse plus radius.

- The aortic root is three sinus lobes joined at the commissures.
- The valve plane is a one-way barrier that a pushed pigtail or wire can cross.
- Coronary lumens come from TreeVessel samples and radii and move with heartMotion and rootDisplacement (S3a).

Contact is a per-node closest point plus Coulomb friction, with hydrophilic vs PTFE coefficients as device parameters.
tasks.acceptance: A rod pushed up from the femoral route reaches the root without escaping the lumen, and the sinuses accept a pigtail. Coronary lumens track the beating heart.

tasks.title: Catheter rest shapes and calibration
tasks.detail:
Rewrite catheters.ts behaviour scalars (reach, naturalAzimuth, seatHeight) as curvature profiles for JL3.5/4/5, JR4, Tiger, AL1, EBU/XB guides and pigtail.

- Stiffness values must be sourced or fitted, never typed from memory.
- Rest shapes are calibrated against catheter silhouettes traced in pre-contrast CoronaryDominance frames, using the anatomy trace tools.
- wires.ts gains stiffness gradients and tip loads from manufacturer specifications, with each source cited.
tasks.acceptance: Projected engaged shapes in the aortic root match traced real shapes within a mean distance of 2 mm at catheter scale.

tasks.title: Engagement as a read-only classifier plus manoeuvre regression tests
tasks.detail:
computeEngagement reads rod geometry: tip inside the ostial lumen, depth, coaxiality (tip tangent dot ostium axis), wall contact force, and the gap area the ostium leaves open (sent to S9 pressure and S5 transport).

- Delete the difficulty-dependent THRESH and the prolapse jump rule. Difficulty comes from anatomy.
- manoeuvres.test.ts runs scripted hand trajectories:
  - JR4 in the right cusp with clockwise roll and slow withdrawal engages the RCA coaxially.
  - Tiger turned anticlockwise in the left sinus engages the LM.
  - Pushing after RCA engagement deep-seats.
  - JL3.5, JL4 and JL5 fit small, normal and dilated roots differently.
- Only manoeuvres supported by docs/reference become tests, after clinician review.
tasks.acceptance: All approved manoeuvre tests pass, with no engagement from torque alone without the right height and withdrawal.

tasks.title: Nested rods and exchanges
tasks.detail:
Model the 0.035 J-wire inside the catheter inside the sheath, constrained to the outer lumen. This replaces the straight two-point wire line in FluoroView.

- Catheter exchange over the wire.
- Wire tracking around the arch.
- Subclavian tortuosity straightens on deep inspiration (respiration couples to lumen geometry).
- Wire into the descending aorta is corrected in LAO with a deep breath (Medmastery handbook).
tasks.acceptance: Exchanging without a wire in the aorta is physically possible but the catheter tip can drop out of position. The wire is rendered as a curved rod.

tasks.title: Hub reactions for feel, sound and pressure
tasks.detail: Each step outputs the hub axial and torsional reaction, stored twist (released as hub spin-back), per-node contact force and stick-slip events. These go to the haptics gain and rumble (S8), audio (S15), complication hazards (S14) and tip-pressure gap (S9).
tasks.acceptance: Reaction channels are available at 60 Hz or more to the main thread. Releasing a wound catheter visibly unwinds the hub.

streams.title: Hands, grips, pedals and input devices
streams.goal: Replace abstract keys, drag-to-steer and step buttons with two-handed grips, 1:1 push and roll, pinning, regrips and independent foot pedals on mouse, trackpad, gamepad and USB/MIDI/HID hardware.
touchesSharedFiles: src/ui/sim/CatheterHub.tsx (owner S10): removed and replaced by TableView, done by S10

tasks.title: HandState and grip mapping
tasks.detail:
Pointer lock uses requestPointerLock({unadjustedMovement:true}) per MDN. Holding the button grips the current device.

- dy is push/pull at a calibrated 1:1 mm per count.
- dx is roll, theta = 2dx/D for the gripped diameter (catheter hub, torque device, balloon shaft).
- Each grip has a limited roll span before a regrip is needed. On release, stored twist unwinds through the hub.
- Left-hand hold keys pin the wire or guide. An unpinned wire is dragged by device advance.
- Switching grips with keys 1-5 takes a short animated move.
- Commands stream to physicsClient.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests cover the mapping, the roll span and regrip, and pin semantics. Input-to-physics latency is at most one frame.

tasks.title: Independent pedals and foot switches
tasks.detail:
Fluoro is F and cine is C, held. Also supported:
- USB HID foot switches through WebHID
- MIDI pedals through Web MIDI
- gamepad triggers

All are dead-man: releasing a pedal stops the beam. Each source is feature-detected and degrades to keyboard.
tasks.acceptance: Each source maps to the same ImagingState pedal fields, and a release stops the beam within one frame.
tasks.verify: input.test.ts with mocked APIs; manual test with a keyboard.

tasks.title: Gamepad and haptic feedback from forces
tasks.detail:
Gamepad sticks drive C-arm and table velocity; triggers are the pedals and the syringe. Rumble follows the rod contact force and snap events.

In haptics.ts, MousePseudoHapticsAdapter gain comes from the hub reaction force instead of UI meters. The WebHIDHapticsAdapter stub becomes a documented report format for a DIY torquer (rotary encoder for roll, linear sensor for push).
tasks.acceptance: Pushing against resistance lowers pseudo-haptic gain smoothly, and rumble amplitude scales with contact force.
tasks.verify: input.test.ts; manual check with a gamepad.

tasks.title: Calibration screen and TableView
tasks.detail:
InputCalibration asks the user to move the mouse a known distance on an on-screen ruler and stores mm per count.

TableView is a bottom strip showing:
- the hands
- the sheath hub, catheter, Y-connector with O-ring state, and torque device
- the manifold taps, syringe contents and transducer

The hub turns with rod roll. There are no meters or numeric readouts.
tasks.acceptance: Calibration persists per device. TableView reflects the rod hub roll and pin state in real time.
tasks.verify: Visual check in the dev build.

streams.title: Patient engine, haemodynamics, ECG and transducer chain
streams.goal: One seeded patient whose circulation, rhythm, pressures, 12-lead ECG, symptoms and drug responses react to every action on the shared CardiacClock, shown on a real haemodynamic monitor in every lab.
touchesSharedFiles: src/ui/sections/AngioPci.tsx (owner S10): mount HaemoMonitor (it currently has no ECG or pressure)

tasks.title: Seeded patient generator
tasks.detail:
patient.ts produces:
- demographics and habitus (feeds S4 and S6)
- BP, heart rate and rhythm, including AF
- LV function and LVEDP
- eGFR and CrCl, weight, allergies, anticoagulation
- anxiety and vagal tone
- radial calibre and root size
- the indication

Lesion location and grade are sampled from the AngioCAD joint distribution conditioned on indication (412 patients; for example mid LAD abnormal in 265 of 412, left main normal in 382 of 412). caseGenerator.ts attaches the patient.
tasks.acceptance: The marginals of 1,000 sampled patients reproduce the AngioCAD lesion frequencies within 3 percentage points. No two seeds share identical haemodynamics.

tasks.title: Patient engine on the shared clock
tasks.detail:
Run circulation.step at its DT, with patient parameters, beat by beat on the CardiacClock. It owns aortic pressure, LV pressure and volume, coronary flow per territory (exports coronaryFlow for S5), and pericardial volume and pressure (tamponade).

LV volume gives a normalised elastance e(t), cross-checked against the S3a waveform. The same clock drives the ECG and image timing.
tasks.acceptance: QRS onset and the image ejection phase stay aligned within 20 ms over 60 s. Pericardial volume increase lowers BP monotonically.

tasks.title: Tip pressure and transducer chain
tasks.detail:
Tip pressure depends on location:
- In the root it is aortic pressure.
- At an ostium it is a chamber connected to the aorta through the residual gap conductance (gap area from S7) and to the distal bed. Damping and ventricularisation then emerge, and RCA ventricularisation comes through conus or RV-branch run-off.
- In the LV it is LV pressure.

transducer.ts adds:
- a second-order system whose natural frequency and damping depend on tubing length, line air and compliance
- a hydrostatic offset of 7.4 mmHg per 10 cm (Deranged Physiology)
- a zero offset until zeroed
- a fast-flush square-wave response
- catheter-tip spasm as an ostial radius state reversed by IC GTN

The fixed numbers in pressure.ts are removed.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests: a deep-seated tip loses the dicrotic notch and diastolic pressure falls, a bubble lowers the natural frequency, raising the transducer 10 cm lowers the reading by about 7.4 mmHg, and an unzeroed transducer shows an offset.

tasks.title: Responses, 12-lead ECG and arrhythmia management
tasks.detail:
responses.ts handles each beat from exposures:
- contrast mass per territory gives transient bradycardia and ST change
- occluded myocardium fraction from balloon, wedge or no-reflow gives territory ST vectors
- vagal tone, pain and anxiety
- drugs: heparin with an ACT clock, GTN, verapamil cocktail, adenosine with AV block, atropine, vasopressor

ecg12.ts projects territory vectors onto lead vectors.

VF becomes a management sequence: recognise, charge, clear, shock, check rhythm, and CPR if delayed. Time to shock affects outcome.

Every magnitude and time constant is sourced into SIM_FACTS before it ships.
tasks.acceptance: LAD occlusion produces ST elevation in anterior leads. Adenosine produces transient AV block and symptoms. VF does not resolve without a shock, and the delay affects the post-shock state.

tasks.title: HaemoMonitor in every lab
tasks.detail: Shows ECG II plus a second lead, aortic or tip pressure, numerics and SpO2, with a 12-lead snapshot on request. It exposes a QRS event for the audio beep, and the dose stub is removed.
tasks.acceptance: Mounted in the diagnostic and PCI labs. Waveforms are synchronised to the clock.
tasks.verify: Visual check plus a telemetry timestamp check.

tasks.title: Contrast and renal budget
tasks.detail: Track the patient-specific maximum acceptable contrast dose (Cigarroa) and the contrast/CrCl ratio from delivered contrast, using the sourced formulas in SIM_FACTS item 22. The nurse announces thresholds (via S15).
tasks.acceptance: The values are correct against the formula, with denominators labelled.

streams.title: Lab shell, pedal-driven imaging, C-arm and reference review (lab UI owner)
streams.goal: Turn the dashboard-style labs into a full-screen cath lab. Only real-lab information is visible. Imaging happens only while a pedal is held, the C-arm and table move physically, and runs are stored and reviewed on a reference monitor.
touchesSharedFiles: src/render/xray/XrayRenderer.ts (owner S2): no shader change; shutters, wedges and profile are set through ImageParams

tasks.title: Remove ground truth and meters behind a visibility policy
tasks.detail:
visibility.ts maps SessionMode to VisibilityPolicy (contract in S1). In supervised, solo and exam modes, remove:
- the header StatusChips and the live coach line
- raw eng.kind codes
- the tip-angle readout
- PUSH/TWIST/RESIST meters
- the RESISTANCE bar and the TORQUE WHIP and TIP IN LV banners
- PCI wire mm-from-ostium and 'across the lesion' readouts
- the device-to-lesion offset
- auto-revealed QCA
- bold recommended views
- the traps list

Overlays (labels, ostia, valve plane, transparent tree) default to off, and stay locked off in exam mode. Teach mode keeps explanations only in the attending drawer.
tasks.acceptance: A render test confirms no eng.kind or eng.message text appears in solo or exam modes, and that overlays cannot be enabled in exam mode.
tasks.verify: New vitest plus @testing-library render test (or a DOM query in dev) per mode.

tasks.title: Pedal-driven imaging and cine series
tasks.detail:
LiveMonitor is shared by both labs, with last-image hold. The image updates only while the fluoro or cine pedal is held. Delete AngioPci live.current.until = now + 900 and the fixed 4.2 s cine.

- A cine run is the pedal interval, pushed to useSeriesStore as a CineSeries.
- Fluoro pps and cine fps are separate.
- The injection comes from the syringe grip (S5 and S8).
- Breath-hold is a command (S1 respiration).
- The heart rate and clock are passed into buildXrayScene.
- Instant catheter swap keys 1-9, R reset, drag-to-steer on the image and the CatheterHub dial are removed and replaced by S8 grips and TableView.
tasks.acceptance: With no pedal held there are 0 X-ray frames and last-image hold is shown. Each run's length is the operator's choice. Runs appear in the series store with dose and contrast.

tasks.title: Full-screen LabLayout
tasks.detail:
The monitor bank holds:
- the live monitor
- the reference monitor
- the HaemoMonitor (S9)
- the DosePanel (S6)

TableView (S8) runs along the bottom. Command palette and captions slots are reserved for S15. A collapsible attending drawer appears in Teach mode only (S11).

The theme is neutral dark with no vendor branding or layout copy. Simulator and AngioPci become thin case configs on one layout and session store.
tasks.acceptance: Both labs use LabLayout with no SectionShell panels or select menus for devices. Layout works at 1280x800.

tasks.title: C-arm dynamics, table and collimation controls
tasks.detail:
carm.ts converts commanded angular velocity from the joystick (gamepad stick or held arrows) into motion with acceleration, a speed cap and a dead-man stop. Presets are stored positions driven while the key is held.

- Continuous angles are shown on the monitor.
- The table pans with inertia during imaging and has a height control.
- Shutter and wedge controls feed ImageParams.
tasks.acceptance: View changes take physical time. Angles off the 5-degree grid are reachable, as in 88-89% of real runs. Shutters reduce KAP (S6).
tasks.verify: Unit tests in carm; dose check.

tasks.title: Reference monitor, stored fluoro and trainee QCA
tasks.detail:
SeriesBrowser offers thumbnails, looping, frame stepping and selection of a reference frame. The last N seconds of fluoro can be stored.

QcaTool works on a stored frame: the trainee picks the frame and segment and calibrates on the catheter. Edge detection carries realistic error, and the result is labelled as the trainee's own measurement.
tasks.acceptance: QCA is available only on stored frames, and calibration on a 6F catheter gives an error within realistic bounds.
tasks.verify: Unit test of the QCA pipeline on a synthetic frame with known diameters.

tasks.title: Generic ECG-gated roadmap and marker-registered stent enhancement
tasks.detail:
Both are generic teaching tools, not vendor copies.

Roadmap:
- After a cine, store one iodine-channel mask per 16 cardiac phase bins.
- During fluoro, overlay the current-phase mask.
- Breathing mismatch shows when the patient is not holding their breath.
- Contrast saved is counted.

Marker enhancement:
- Use the two balloon marker positions with simulated detection noise.
- Register by similarity transform and average about 2 s of cine.
tasks.acceptance: The roadmap overlay aligns within 1 px during breath-hold and drifts visibly with free breathing. The enhanced image shows stent edges and under-expansion.
tasks.verify: Visual capture; unit test of the registration.

streams.title: Mentor, telemetry, metrics, debrief and replay
streams.goal: An attending who speaks at the right moment and fades with competence, objective metrics against cited standards, and PEARLS debriefs with deterministic replay and rewind-to-decision-point.
touchesSharedFiles: src/state/useSimulatorStore.ts (owner S10): event timestamps use wall-clock tWall instead of round(fluoroTime) (lines ~237, ~503); finishCase must not add fluoroTime as training time
src/simulation/srs.ts (owner S12): dueIds() includes SkillCard ids

tasks.title: Procedure recorder and deterministic replay
tasks.detail:
ProcedureRecorder subscribes to the stores and physics client and stores 10 Hz columns as Int16-quantised typed arrays:
- tWall and tFluoro
- commanded and actual insertion and torque, and wire
- tip pose, engagement class and pressure class
- systolic and diastolic pressure
- C-arm angles, field and pps
- beam and cine state
- contrast and dose

It also records discrete ProcEvents and the full input-command log plus the session seed, so replay is exact through S7 and S9 determinism.

The last 50 attempts are kept in IndexedDB (about 240 kB per 10-minute case) through a small idb.ts wrapper with try/catch.
tasks.acceptance: Replaying a recorded case reproduces tip pose within 0.1 mm and an identical event sequence.
tasks.verify: npx vitest run src/mentor/mentor.test.ts with a scripted session.

tasks.title: Objective metrics and segment coverage
tasks.detail:
metrics.ts computes DiagnosticMetrics and PciMetrics:
- procedure time, fluoro time, cine runs, contrast, Ka,r and KAP
- engagement attempts and time to selective engagement
- LV entries and damped-trace events
- inject-while-damped
- aspiration and pressure-check compliance
- early and late catheter changes
- injection quality: pre-contrast frames present, distal bed filled, filmed at least 2 cycles after peak

coverage.ts uses projection.ts per stored run and per AHA segment to compute foreshortening and overlap with other opacified segments and the catheter. A segment counts as seen if it is unforeshortened and unoverlapped in at least two views.

All 15 never-raised MistakeCodes are raised from these metrics.
tasks.acceptance: All 24 MistakeCodes can fire in scripted scenarios. Coverage flags a segment that was seen only in a foreshortened view.

tasks.title: Passing standards and expert calibration
tasks.detail:
standards.ts defines PassingStandard {epa, metric, op, value, source, critical}.

- Default for a full diagnostic study: zero critical errors, 8 standardised cine loops, under 10 min, fluoro under 3 min and contrast under 50 mL, labelled 'jensen-2016' (EuroIntervention RCT criterion).
- In Expert calibration mode, trainer runs export a benchmark JSON (export and import), and that benchmark becomes the local standard.
- The UI shows the source of every threshold. The composite score is formative only.
tasks.acceptance: The standards evaluate correctly, and the source label is shown in the debrief.

tasks.title: Attending engine with escalation ladder
tasks.detail:
Each MentorRule has a trigger on rolling context, a persistence time, a severity (safety, technique or efficiency), a ladder (L1 question, L2 cue, L3 instruction, L4 stop), a cooldown and frame options.

- The starting level depends on entrustment.
- Exam mode allows L4 safety stops only, logged as critical errors.
- A time-out fires after 60 s with no progress or more than 3 re-approaches.
- Phrasing is generated from rod and pressure state ('your trace has lost its dicrotic notch...').
- Optional speechSynthesis uses only voices with localService true.

Feedback is terminal-heavy for novices (Walsh 2009; Hatala 2014). Delays and cooldowns are tunable defaults, not literature values.

Starter rules:
- damped trace before injection
- conus over-selection
- LV entry
- pushing against resistance
- injecting without a clean aspirate
- a view that foreshortens the target
- wire in a septal branch
- device advanced beyond the wire
- oversized balloon outside the lesion
- stent deployed without a positioning injection
tasks.acceptance: Each rule fires in its scripted scenario at the expected level per mode. In exam mode the only utterances are stops.

tasks.title: Pre-brief and time-out
tasks.detail:
The ProcedurePlan records access, catheters (first and backup), planned views, contrast budget, anticipated difficulty, and for PCI the guide, wire, strategy and heparin.

- prebriefs.ts holds 2-4 case-specific questions per preset or scenario, with expected answers.
- A time-out checklist (patient and procedure, contrast allergy, renal function and budget, anticoagulation, access, devices) must be completed before the beam is enabled in supervised and exam modes.
- The previous case's 'next time I will...' line is shown.
tasks.acceptance: The beam is blocked until the time-out is done in supervised and exam modes. Plan versus execution appears in the debrief.
tasks.verify: Manual check plus a mentor.test.ts assertion.

tasks.title: PEARLS debrief with replay and rewind
tasks.detail:
The debrief follows four phases:
1. Reactions: a self-rating of 1-5 per EPA sub-skill, plus a plus/delta note.
2. Description: a narrative generated automatically from the timeline.
3. Analysis: up to 3 gaps, ranked by severity times recurrence. Directive feedback with a replay clip covers evident technique gaps. Advocacy-inquiry with selectable frames covers decision gaps, and each frame unlocks targeted teaching.
4. Summary: the learner picks a take-home, sees the metrics table and has skill cards scheduled.

ReplayTimeline shows swimlanes and re-renders X-ray frames from recorded state through buildXrayScene. Rewind-and-branch restores the physics and patient snapshot at any auto-detected decision point.

The debrief also shows self-rating calibration and a structured report (dominance, lesions by segment, severity, TIMI) compared against ground truth.
tasks.acceptance: Scrubbing renders the correct frame within 100 ms. A branch from a decision point continues deterministically.

tasks.title: Show-me demonstrator and expert ghosts
tasks.detail:
demonstrator.ts runs a short-horizon model-predictive search over discrete hub actions, using the rod solver in fast-forward as the forward model.

Cost terms:
- height and azimuth error to the target ostium
- penalties for deep or LV states
- a penalty for pushing against resistance

'Show me' plays the plan as a ghost hub with timed prompts. It counts as a hint at the current entrustment level.

Recorded expert trajectories are compared using DTW and economy-of-motion metrics: total insertion and torque travel, torque reversals, time to coaxial.
tasks.acceptance: The demonstrator reaches selective coaxial engagement from the sinus in at least 90% of 50 generated cases.

tasks.title: Procedural skill cards
tasks.detail:
Each skill card is a 1-3 minute micro-scenario that starts at the moment of a specific error, for example:
- the tip in the conus
- a ventricularised RCA
- a wire in S1
- an oversized balloon loaded

Cards are graded on measured outcome, not self-report, and scheduled with srs.ts SM-2. Every MISTAKE_INFO drill becomes a real template. Ledger weights decay as exp(-delta days / 14).
tasks.acceptance: Each MISTAKE_INFO drill button launches its scenario, and grading updates the SRS memory.

streams.title: Progression, entrustment and logbook
streams.goal: Replace game progression with an EPA entrustment model, a simulator logbook, competency-ordered case ladders, a real exam mode and spaced procedural practice.
touchesSharedFiles: src/ui/sim/CoachPanel.tsx (owner S10): remove Scorebar import and usage
src/types/index.ts (owner S1): ProgressProfile.logbook and ProgressProfile.entrustment fields

tasks.title: Remove game mechanics and migrate profiles
tasks.detail:
Delete:
- XP (useProgressStore line ~95) and level titles (curriculum.ts 165-176)
- the day streak (App.tsx 191-193) and the Dashboard XP line
- the mid-case Scorebar
- hint efficiency penalties
- the 'obsessive' 600-minute intensity
